decisions.issues: Minor only. Nagoji's extended leg at the bottom-left frame edge shows the ankle with no visible iron (the foot is cropped by the frame, and the hobble chain runs from Keshavrao's ankles under Nagoji's dhoti). The hold reads dim amber with bright plank-seam slits rather than truly near dark. Otherwise clean: Nagoji has a curled moustache, a clean chin with light stubble and the gold ear stud. Keshavrao has short ragged hair, a faint moustache, a grey-brown tunic and no stud; he shivers with his knees drawn up. One slack chain runs from the beam ring to Nagoji's collar and on to Keshavrao's collar. The frame is canted, the dipper hangs off true from its peg and the trough sits at the right. There is no painted text. The top band of ceiling beams is clear for both balloons (Nagoji's above his head at upper left-centre, Keshavrao's at upper right, clear of the dipper). v07 is the identical image with painted balloons whose tails point at the correct speakers.

Clean. The collar chain now leaves the collar ring below the chin and droops slack to a ring on the hull planks. Keshavrao has a faint moustache, short ragged hair and no ear stud, his face turned toward the hull. His manacled right hand is half-curled at his hip and his left hand rests on his knee, with the wrist chain slack across his lap. The ankle cuffs have a hobble chain and the hands are sound. The large plank wall at right gives clear space for the balloon. Minor: the left hand lies on the knee rather than right beside the right hand, and the wrist chain is a little longer than a forearm. v07 is not usable as a backup because its collar chain runs through his mouth and chin.
